title: WPPIL/191/2016 of Rajveer Singh Vs State Of Uttarakhand

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (PIL) No. 191 of 2016
With
Delay Condonation Application in CA No. 8632 of 2017
Rajveer Singh. ............ Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand & others. .............. Respondents
Mr. S.K. Mandal, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Pradeep Joshi, Standing Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand / respondents.
JUDGMENT
Coram: Hon'ble K.M. Joseph, C.J.
 Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
 Dated: 21st July, 2017
K.M. JOSEPH, C.J. (Oral)
 Delay in filing the counter affidavit is condoned. Counter affidavit
filed on behalf of respondent No. 3 is taken on record. The Application,
made therefor, is disposed of.
2. The prayers in this writ petition are as follows:
"I. Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus
directing and commanding the respondents to make
demarcation of revenue land of Village Pipaliya and the
reserved forest land Plot No. 47, 48, 49, 50, 51, 53, 53A of
Barakoli Range, Sitarganj, District Udham Singh Nagar and
the appropriate steps to protect the reserved forest land may
be taken expeditiously as possible s earlier.
II. Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus
directing and commanding the respondents to protect the
green trees and illegal selling of forest soil in Barakoli
Range, Sitarganj, District Udham Singh Nagar and the
necessary action may be taken against the offenders."
3. Briefly put, the case of the petitioner is as follows:

2
 Petitioner made a complaint that the employees working in the
concerned range of the forest are cutting the green trees and permitting the
villagers to encroach upon the forest land. It is alleged that they are also
digging and taking away the soil from the forest land and are selling the
same illegally for the purpose of their own benefit and about 100 acres of
forest land has been encroached in collusion with the forest employees. It
is the further case that the Divisional Forest Officer submitted a report to
the Chief Conservator of Forest, Uttarakhand, and submitted that some
forest officers along with the villagers are doing agricultural work on the
forest land with collaboration and 12 hectares of land is being cultivated
with the Forest Range Officer and there is encroachment of forest land.
There is reference to a show-cause notice issued by the Sub Divisional
Forest Officer. There is further reference to a letter sent by him to SDM
Sitarganj for demarcation and fixation of the pillars so that the villagers,
who have encroached upon the forest land, can be removed. There is
further reference to an order passed by the Lokayukta and a letter sent by
the ADM, Nazool, Udham Singh Nagar, to the Divisional Forest Officer.
Petitioner made representations and is before us.
4. Counter affidavit has been filed on behalf of respondent No. 3.
Therein, it is, inter alia, stated as follows:
"4. That the contents of paragraph no. 7, 8 & 9 of the writ
petition are admitted to the extent that the representation
dated 27.10.2010 of the petitioner was received, however, the
allegation of the petitioner that the Forest Employees posted
in Barakoli Range are helping the villagers in not only
encroaching the forest land and cutting trees were found to
be wrong and baseless, after conducting a detailed inquiry in
the matter through Sub Divisional Forest Officer, Sitarganj.
A copy of the inquiry report has already been annexed by the
petitioner as Annexure No. 2 to the writ petition. It is
submitted that pursuant to the report one Sri Kashmir Singh
s/o Goma Singh (working as daily wager in the department)
who was found to have illegally encroached upon 0.75
hectare forest land utilizing the forest land for agriculture
purposes, was removed as daily wager and encroachment
over the said land was also removed.
It is submitted that Sub Divisional Forest Officer,
Sitarganj call a meeting on 20.09.2011 in the Shakti Farm

3
Forest Rest House in which the petitioner was also called
along with Gram Pradhan and other public representatives
for redressal of the grievance of the petitioner and spot
inspection. The petitioner along with Gram Pradhan and
other public representatives, in the said meeting dated
20.09.2011 apprised in writing that their grievances has been
redressed and now he has no complaint whatsoever. Copy of
the written statement of the petitioner dated 20.09.2011
bearing the signature of public representatives as well as
villagers is being annexed as Annexure CA-1 to this
affidavit.
5. That the contents of paragraph no. 10 of the writ petition are
admitted being matters of record. However, it is stated that
as stated in preceding paragraph the encroachment made by
Kashmir Singh, Daily Wager over the forest land was not
only removed, the services of Kashmir Singh as daily wager
was also dispensed with.
9. That the contents of paragraph no. 16 of the writ petition are
not admitted as stated and hence denied. In reply it is
submitted that the encroachment made by Daily Wager
Kashmir Singh was removed and in the meeting held on
20.09.2011 the petitioner submitted in writing that his
grievance has been redressed, however, it is relevant to state
here that the work of joint survey to be conducted in terms of
the directions of the Hon'ble Lokayukta could not be
completed. As soon as this issue came into the knowledge of
the new incumbent, DFO Tarai East by his letter no.
2105/29-3(3) dated 16.01.2017 has requested DM Udham
Singh Nagar for conducting a joint survey as soon as
possible.
10. That in reply to the contents of paragraph no. 17 of the writ
petition it is stated that the representation of petitioner dated
13.08.2014 was inquired upon by the Sub Divisional Forest
Officer, Sitarganj and on 29.10.2014 again the petitioner was
called at the site. After perusal of the record of the Range, it
was found that cases regarding illegal digging of soil and
cutting of trees have already been registered and
consequently, the petitioner was also satisfied with the same.
Copy of the written statement of the petitioner dated
29.10.2014 addressed to the Sub Divisional Forest Officer,
Sitarganj is being annexed as Annexure CA-2 to this
affidavit.
11. That in reply to the contents of paragraph no. 18 & 19 of the
writ petition it is stated that again the representation dated
30.05.2016 was acted upon and after due inquiry by the Sub
Divisional Forest Officer, Sitarganj the complaints were
found incorrect and baseless and accordingly a report to this
effect was sent to the Divisional Forest Officer, Tarai East
Forest Division, Haldwani. In the inquiry it came into light
that 04 trees of Eucalyptus and Teak had fallen in the
Campus of Forest establishment Shaktifarm due to wind and

4
the same were taken in the C-1 stock register of the Forest
Department. Copy of the report dated 28.09.2016 is being
annexed as Annexure-CA3 to this affidavit."
5. We have heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the
learned Standing Counsel for the State.
6. As far as the prayer regarding demarcation is concerned, it seems
dealt with in paragraph 9 of the counter affidavit, which we have already
extracted above. Learned counsel for the petitioner would also submit
that, in the light of the counter affidavit, the matter can be disposed of.
7. We record the aforesaid statements made in the counter affidavit
and dispose of the writ petition; besides directing that the joint survey and
the demarcation work will be completed at the earliest.

(Alok Singh, J.) (K.M. Joseph, C. J.)
 21.07.2017 21.07.2017
G
